title: 名人是否要放弃隐私

title: 年龄限制

question.en: Age restrictions can be seen everywhere. It is believed that people should not do things until they reach the right age, such as marriage, and driving. Select one activity and state the minimum age that you think. Support with your own experiences.
question.zh: 年龄限制随处可见。有人认为，人们应达到合适年龄后才能做某些事情，例如结婚和开车。请选择一种活动，说明你认为适合的最低年龄，并用自己的经历支持观点。

body2.en: For example, a grandfather can watch his grandchildren grow up.

body2.label: 回扣
body2.en: This can make family life happier.

paragraphs.en: First, doing a task makes it easier to remember. This is because students connect an idea with a real action. Teachers can still explain the main idea first. Practice then gives students a simple way to check whether they understood it. For example, I grew a plant in class and remembered that it needed water. When the soil became dry, I added water and watched the plant improve. The lesson was connected to something I could see. This helped me remember the lesson.
paragraphs.zh: 亲手做一件事让人更容易记住。这是因为学生把知识与实际行动联系起来。老师仍可以先讲主要知识，再通过实践让学生检查自己是否理解。例如，我在课堂上种植物，记住了植物需要水。土干后，我浇水并看到植物状态变好，知识和看得见的东西联系起来了。这帮助我记住课堂内容。
